_doc: Hand-written narrative inputs of the third-pass report (write_test_status.py formats the counts in; make_doc.py writes REPORT.md). The run results below were copied from what was seen.
result_paragraph: Gate Q16 is **not passing** and `passes` is set nowhere. By decision DD-PM-01 there are still **0 documented camera positions** (a coordinate, a lens and a plate): none of the {n_statements} position statements (Library of Congress records, National Park Service reports, place pages and the Record of Treatment) is one. What is new: (1) the National Park Service names the camera place of two catalogued exposures as a building of known outline, the first documented camera places: the roof of the Evergreen Cemetery lodge (view north: records 2018671576 and 2014646001, poses P27 north and P28 northwest, two words of two NPS texts for one exposure) and the gatehouse (view east: record 2012647704, pose P29); their height, lens and exact heading are not documented. (2) The pass criteria of the tests at those places were written before the renders (criteria.json). Results: P27 {v27}, P28 {v28}, P29 {v29}; P13 (rendered now) {v13}. The three binary tests of the first criterion are necessary conditions only (the superseded poses P06 and P07 pass them too and are does not); the skyline tests fit the heading, the lens and a vertical shift to the photograph and are compared with 24 control stations: {sky27}; {sky28}; {sky29}. No pose is called a match. (3) The Record of Treatment prints {n_figs} captioned 1863 photographs with a direction of view; {n_tied_all} are tied to catalogued Library of Congress records ({n_ties} by image match confirmed by looking, the others by the Digital ID in the caption), the others are prints of the park and other collections. (4) A wider search of the Library of Congress (the whole Civil War group) added {n_wide} records ({n_wide_tied} tied to a catalogued exposure): the registry now holds {n_records} records and {n_poses} poses. (5) Re-running the renderer reproduced the renders of the earlier sessions pixel for pixel (see the determinism line below). What would settle Q16: station coordinates, lens and plate from the park (an owner step), the height and 1863 form of the gatehouse, a 1863 near-field model, landmark coordinates good to a few metres, and a value for T-Q16-1 written before the match (all in PHOTOMATCH.md).
what_was_run: State found: the earlier run of this pass was cut short by the container restart at 00:05 UTC (renders of P27 and P28 never made, the wide-search script run only in part, a P13 sheet without a verdict). Continued from it, nothing redone: every saved image file was re-hashed (436 files match their ledger entries; 11 entries are working copies or originals that were deleted by design), the wide search was completed and the poses rendered.

`wide_search.py` (completed; the not-digitized records are now recorded as such, not as failures): 183 photographs of 1863 naming Gettysburg in the open JSON search of the whole Civil War group (950 results), {n_wide} not held before; 57 medium JPEGs saved at 1 request per second (one truncated download re-fetched), 5 records not digitized; the 62 item records fetched; each image looked at on four contact sheets and classified by hand (`wide_data.py`): staged flags set on 6 (the sharpshooter and Devil's Den series, the posed scene of 11 November, a print whose printed number 251 is the sharpshooter negative).

`scan_nps_photos.py`: one fixed rule over all 118 saved NPS texts and pages: 340 passages that give a place or direction of view of a photograph, 15 already statements; read in full. It found the Record of Treatment figure captions (about forty 1863 photographs with a direction and a park number) that no earlier pass had used, and confirmed that no NPS publication or page read gives a coordinate, a lens or a plate.

`nps_figures.py`: the two PDFs of the Record of Treatment (294 and 189 MB) fetched again with one request each (sha256 equal to the manifest of the first fetch), 36 captions cut verbatim from the saved text and the 36 images extracted with pdfimages (the historic photographs are stored inverted: inverted to positive), the PDFs deleted; {n_fig_stmts} new figure statements generated (5 of the 36 captions were already statements).

`match_third_pass.py` (SIFT, ratio test, RANSAC; one FLANN index per candidate; through the machine lock, about 25 minutes): 36 figure images, {n_wide} wide-search images and the 6 Metropolitan Museum items against 288 catalogued images; {n_ties} figure ties confirmed by looking at both images (nps_figures_confirmed.json) in addition to the ties by Digital ID; {n_wide_tied} wide records tied to a catalogued exposure; the Metropolitan Museum items: see wide_to_catalogue.json and met_to_catalogue.json.

Poses and criteria: P13 rendered and looked at; P27 and P28 (one exposure, two NPS words) and P29 (the view east, which the matching showed to be record 2012647704) registered with their pre-written criteria (criteria.json: C-P27-P28-1 at 00:01:29Z by the interrupted run, C-P27-P28-2 at 00:31:42Z, C-P29-1 at 00:44:11Z, each before the render or the model skyline of its pose); the renders made through the lock; `measure_c1.py` (the three binary tests; the definition was written before the render and tested only on the other poses P06 and P07); `skyline_test.py` (24 control stations each; the first computation of the model skyline was a smoke test on the station only, run after the criteria were written; the lock run reproduces it).

Statements: {n_statements} (was 70): the Record of Treatment figures, the record texts of the wide search (leads where the Library cites Frassanito), the caption of the Culp's Hill print; evidence lines R12.032 to R12.035 rebuilt (every quote checked again against the saved text: 0 failures); the library pointers (acquired_3.json, status_3.json) updated; five blocked or failed sources recorded (NARA catalog, five records not digitized, the Sketch Book text, a Gutenberg edition that does not exist, the lodge-roof negative now found).

Document and registry rebuilt from the data (`catalogue_wide_items.py`, `build_registry.py`, `make_doc.py`); `add_verdicts_third_pass.py` wrote the verdicts of P13, P27, P28 and P29 after the sheets and the lines-on-photograph images were looked at.
findings: The National Park Service's Record of Treatment (2018) is a source of camera directions and, for some, camera places for about forty July 1863 photographs (park numbers 2B-2063, 2B-2090 and so on); the park's own catalogue is the next step toward stations (owner step). The captions double as 1863 landscape evidence (orchards, fences, woodlots of the Rose, Sherfy, Weikert and McPherson farms): the nps-landscape and vegetation lanes may cite them.
The model's outline of the Evergreen Cemetery gatehouse is the 2023 footprint with the right-hand addition; the camera stood on or in the 1855 building (EG-13).
Two NPS texts give two words for the direction of the lodge-roof view, north and northwest; read from the photograph (an exploratory reading, not a test) the heading lies at their boundary (EG-14).

The Leister house photograph (cwpb 00887) is called a view north along the Taneytown Road by the Then-And-Now page and a view northwest by the Record of Treatment: a 45-degree conflict carried as statements; pose P18 follows the first.

The old test tests/photomatch.test.mjs fails on the new ledger and schema (request note bt-web-photomatch-old-test.md); the Q16 section of GATE-SPEC should be refreshed from the files (request note bt-gates-photomatch-third-pass.md).
owed: No real-GPU rendering: every render is software GL (SwiftShader); nothing here is a timing or a real-GPU visual result.
No master TIFF beyond the two Cemetery Hill views (4096-px working copies kept); no full-resolution matching.

The NARA catalog (reachable, but a JavaScript shell only: its API needs a key, an owner act), the 5 records of the wide search that the Library has not digitized, the Sketch Book letterpress (images only at 1024 px) and the NARA Prologue blog on the Devil's Den sharpshooter (the PDF's source for the staged flag; a host that was not in the list of reachable hosts) were not read.
Figures of the Record of Treatment that no catalogued image matched are statements without a photograph; the park's catalogue numbers (GETT 41135) need the park's help (owner step).
The skyline test could not be applied to the other poses: they have no documented place, and the NPS area words (a farm, a hill) do not fix the camera within the depth of the scene.
governance_note: Nothing was added to requirements.json, gates.json or register/ (proposals ws10-EG-13 to ws10-EG-16 and an update of EG-10 only). `check_governance.py` was run once at the end (exit 0, 0 sub-requirements passing; its coverage lines for Q17, Q18 and Q23 fail on other workstreams' unfinished work): no milestone is claimed. Delegated decisions DD-PM-06 to DD-PM-10 were appended to decisions/DELEGATED-DECISIONS-2026-11-11.md (section I).
